names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 1 марта ст. ст., name page 10089, «Надежда (Аббакумова), мц.», with the grade and rank words left off; the day’s own line declines the forename and gives no surname at all. The surname in brackets is part of the name the calendar’s link gives and is kept. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, and no folder holds the surname in either spelling, while the bare «Надежда» is held only by `hope-daughter-of-sophia`. azbyka.ru spells the surname «Абакумова» with one б and that disagreement is named in the life; the stored form is the calendar’s own.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 марта ст. ст. — «Cщмчч. Василия , Петра , Иоанна , Вениамина , Михаила пресвитеров, прмч. Антония , прмцц. Анны , Дарии , Евдокии , Ольги , Александры , Матроны , мч. Василия , мц. Надежды (1938).»

attestations.note: The line is one line for fourteen people and this folder is one of them. azbyka.ru’s own page for this saint lists two further days besides 14 марта, the synaxis of the new martyrs who suffered at Butovo and the synaxis of the saints of Moscow, both of them moveable and neither a fixed day this corpus can hold; they are named in the life and recorded nowhere else.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's list for 14 martie, the corresponding civil day (5 October 2026).
Not checked: saint.gr's list for 14 Μαρτίου, the corresponding civil day (5 October 2026).
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for 14 March 2026 (5 October 2026).

birth.note: azbyka.ru: «Мученица Надежда (Надежда Петровна Абакумова) родилась в 1880 году в селе Ванилово Бронницкого уезда Московской губернии в крестьянской семье»

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line of the fourteen for 1 марта ст. ст. with «(1938)», and azbyka.ru has her shot on 14 March 1938, which is that Julian 1 March by the civil reckoning: the day of death and the feast are the same day. No day is recorded here because this corpus records years.
